title: ゆるい手書きのひつじ 未年
subject: ひつじ
subject_en: the SAME loosely hand-drawn sheep character: a round cloud-shaped woolly body in warm cream (#FFF6E0, never pure white), a small oval face in soft beige with dot eyes and a tiny smile, two little curled horns, stubby dark-grey legs. Outline is a closed, slightly wobbly dark-grey line all around; no shading.
lead: 2027年の干支、ひつじを、ゆるい手書きのタッチで。年賀状のワンポイント、LINEのあけおめ、おたよりの1月号に。手をふる、もちつき、こたつ、だるまなど、お正月のポーズ12点。
items: あけましておめでとう
bowing politely with both front hooves together
holding a wooden mallet beside a small mortar of rice cake
sitting in a small kotatsu table with a tangerine on top
flying a small square kite on a string
sitting next to a red daruma doll
standing beside a small kadomatsu pine decoration
holding a small blank envelope with both hooves, happy
curled up asleep with a tiny sleep bubble
holding a small red lacquer cup
sitting and looking at a small rising sun behind a hill
